scope: Two candidate eligibility gates only; no pilot or new empirical download.

candidate_A_antibiotic.gate: Novelty fail; data gate not advanced.
candidate_A_antibiotic.chosen_contrast: Pre-exposure fraction of cells neither growing nor dividing versus later ampicillin survivor frequency.

closest_source.title: Observation of persister cell histories reveals diverse modes of survival in antibiotic persistence
closest_source.equation: Eq. 1, f=sP_n; s estimated from late-stationary condition.

candidate_A_antibiotic.data_access: Primary article and Dryad metadata inspected. Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.s1rn8pkb1 lists source data, but archive not downloaded after exact contrast already failed novelty.
candidate_A_antibiotic.independent_units: Not audited after novelty gate failure; plotted figure points are not recast as independent runs.

candidate_B_hiv.gate: Novelty/comparator unresolved and insufficiently differentiated for this stage; data gate partial, not passed.
candidate_B_hiv.fixed_question: Does finite baseline single-bnAb susceptibility sampling alter the chosen pair, and does the choice retain measured combo IC80 coverage on viruses excluded from selection?

wagh_2016.measured_combinations: 10 experimentally tested combinations on a selected 20-virus subset; Methods/Results and Fig. 2. The 20 viruses were chosen for sensitivity to almost all bnAbs and to maximize IC80 range.
wagh_2016.broader_panel_distinction: The 1,622 combination scores across the 200-virus panel are Bliss-Hill predictions, not empirical combination assays.
wagh_2016.availability: Paper states data are available in article/supporting information. The observed paired subset is public, but isolate-level numeric rows and donor/lineage grouping were not reconstructed in this stage.
wagh_2016.local_supplement_schema: Inspected local S1 DOCX and extracted CSV table: one summary coverage table, 21 rows, maximum 7 columns; fields summarize best % coverage by combination size and IC80/IC50 concentration thresholds, not per-isolate neutralization records.
wagh_2016.title: Optimal Combinations of Broadly Neutralizing Antibodies for Prevention and Treatment of HIV-1 Clade C Infection

williamson_2024.calculated: Fig. 4 caption states combination IC50/IC80 values are calculated from observed singles using additive/Bliss-Hill assumptions; not measured combination-assay outcomes.
williamson_2024.method_scope: Held-out pseudovirus prediction plus synthetic sample-size simulations (2,500 simulated datasets; n=100 through 1,000) do not supply empirical combo neutralization or a finite-panel treatment-choice validation.
williamson_2024.access: Article, data-availability section, author-repository README and script inspected. One attempted raw data-folder access was blocked by browser access controls; no raw records downloaded. Public CATNAP single-bnAb source is identified and is not described as unavailable.

laMont_2022.evidence: Closest clinical decision-model comparison: genetic susceptibility used to model clinical rebound and rank antibody cocktails; these ranks are model-derived, not measured combo-neutralization outcomes.
laMont_2022.title: Design of an optimal combination therapy with broadly neutralizing antibodies to suppress HIV-1

hiv_supp_table_0.csv.meaning: aggregate combination-coverage percentages; no isolate-level outcome rows.

hiv_escape_sample.csv.meaning: DMS mutation-level survival fraction, not per-isolate single/combo neutralization.

genetic_inputs.days: Each keyed patient record has day0 and available follow-up days; e.g., patient 91C22 has day0, day98, day112. Day/site records include genetic counts/fields.

viraemic_trace_inputs.schema: Each numbered trace point stores child fields 1 (integer time index) and 2 (float trace value); one first point is -4 and 1430.0. HDF5 itself does not label those child fields with units.

fitted_or_derived_values.source_code: file_access.jl lines 124-136 calculates rebound time as -log(x)/growth; lines 69-85 extracts early genetic theta values for simulations.

hiv_trial_combo.h5.interpretation: Empirical clinical/genetic trace inputs coexist with fitted scalars and modeled rebound/simulation outputs. This is not measured combination-neutralization data and is not an independent holdout for the finite-panel assay question.

candidate_B_hiv.units_and_limits: Wagh has 20 measured virus-level combo outcomes, but their donor/lineage links, replicate structure and exact row joins were not reconstructed. The deliberately selected panel cannot establish representative resistance-tail coverage. The HIVTreatmentOptimization H5 separately preserves seven patient genetic records and seven matching trace records with 10-19 points per person, alongside fitted x/k/growth/decay; repository code derives rebound times and simulates/ranks therapies from these inputs. It is not the selected assay endpoint or an independent neutralization cohort. Do not count concentrations, model predictions or simulations as independent outcomes.
